title: Finite intrinsic projection under constant coefficient realization
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E of Q_l, m≥0, and finite operations S at exponent m+1 [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. There exists a family e, natural in both ambient finite inputs, identifying finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor with evaluatedTensor [def-sf-integral-projection-evaluation-factors]. For every compactified morphism f:X→Y, bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor bounded constructible L on Y [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates], and arbitrary ambient finite objects U,V with isomorphisms k:U≅K.obj and l:V≅L.obj, the intrinsic finite proper/open projection at U,V [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence], followed by support of e_X and tensor of k and finite pullback of l followed by inverse finitePullback, and then inverse finiteSupport, equals e_Y followed by tensor of the realized support of k followed by inverse finiteSupport and l, and then the included fixed-presentation component S f c K L. All factors are the displayed ones in the Lean statement. No coefficient system, integral object, reconstruction, separated structure-map hypothesis, or projection invertibility occurs.

theorem finiteIntrinsicProjectionRealization
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
        finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor C.l E X.obj.left m ≅
          evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X,
      ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X)
        (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E (m + 1)
          (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) Y.obj.left)
        (U : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E X.obj.left m)
        (V : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E Y.obj.left m)
        (k : U ≅ K.obj) (l : V ≅ L.obj),
        SystemProjectionFormula.finiteProjection C.l E D C.different c
            X.obj.hom Y.obj.hom m U V ≫
          (sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map
            ((e X).hom.app (U, (finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m f.hom.left).obj V) ≫
              (evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
                (Prod.mkHom k.hom
                  ((finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m f.hom.left).map l.hom ≫
                    (S.finitePullback f).inv.app ⟨L.obj, L.property.1⟩))) ≫
          (S.finiteSupport f c).inv.app
            (((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.partialTensor S X).obj K).obj
              ((CompactSupportFiniteProjection.torPull S f).obj L)) =
        (e Y).hom.app
            ((sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1)
              (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).obj U, V) ≫
          (evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
            (Prod.mkHom
              ((sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1)
                (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map k.hom ≫
                (S.finiteSupport f c).inv.app K) l.hom) ≫
          (finiteInclusion (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
            (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component S f c K L)
